The plan

One search. More price clarity.

Our goal is to make comparing tickets easier, with useful details presented clearly before you visit a seller to complete your purchase.

Our promise
Clear pricing. No pretend totals.

We plan to distinguish verified checkout totals from estimates. If a marketplace does not provide enough information to confirm the final cost, we will say so.

Free for fans is the goal
Coming together

Ticket Goblin is in development.

We are building the first version and exploring data and affiliate partnerships with ticket marketplaces. Event discovery and ticket inventory access depend on provider approval and availability. Ticket Goblin is not currently selling tickets.

Ticket Goblin is an independent project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Ticketmaster, StubHub, TickPick, SeatGeek, or other ticket marketplaces.
